---
title: "Learning Notes"
subtitle: "Notes from differential modeling lab"
author: "Ben Choat"
date: today
date-format: long
abstract: |
  hold

# Language & Document Settings
lang: en

# Code Output & Execution Options
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false

# Standard Cross-Format Styling Defaults
format:
  # HTML Output Configuration
  html:
    theme:
      light: flatly
      dark: darkly
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: left
    number-sections: true
    code-fold: show
    code-tools: true
    embed-resources: true
    smooth-scroll: true

  # PDF Output Configuration
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    papersize: letter
    geometry:
      - top=1in
      - bottom=1in
      - left=1in
      - right=1in
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    number-sections: true
    colorlinks: true
    linkcolor: blue
    urlcolor: blue
    citecolor: blue

  # Microsoft Word (DOCX) Output Configuration
  docx:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    number-sections: true
    highlight-style: github
    # reference-doc: custom-styles.docx  # Optional: path to reference style template
---
